Guides / Style & Game Corner / Style & cosmetics

Style & cosmetics

All 319 outfits, themes, frames, wallpapers, card backs, ball effects and dolls.

Style items change how your trainer, card, PC and app look. Buy them with Bounty Tickets or money in Events → Style (three items are 30% off each day), pull them from the Game Corner, or win them (Stamp book frames). Glimmer-only looks are in the Glimmer Shop. Friends see your outfit, frame, card, ball effect and Shelf (up to 6 dolls).
